info.title: API.SH: OpenSea
info.description: The OpenSea API from API.SH: public OpenSea data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The marketplace-wide activity feed, newest first (sales by default), optionally for some chains or collections: event type, time, price, from and to, item, collection, marketplace and transaction hash. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensea-activity

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types: sale, mint, transfer, listing, offer, collection_offer, trait_offer, airdrop (default all).

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: Comma-separated chains, e.g. `ethereum,base`.

parameters.name: collections
parameters.description: Comma-separated collection slugs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Items of a collection with the site's filters and sorts: token id, name, link, image, standard, rarity rank, traits, best listing (price, seller, start and end time, quantity, marketplace), best offer, last sale and its date, last transfer, creation date and owner. Filter by listed status, price range, rarity rank range, traits and a search query. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensea-collection-items

parameters.description: Collection slug (as in opensea.io/collection/<slug>) or the collection link.

parameters.description: Sort (default price).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `asc for price and rarity, desc otherwise` (default) or the other way.

parameters.name: listed
parameters.description: true: listed items only; false: unlisted only.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum listing price in the collection's currency.

parameters.name: max_price

parameters.name: min_rank
parameters.description: Best rarity rank to include.

parameters.name: max_rank
parameters.description: Worst rarity rank to include.

parameters.name: traits
parameters.description: Trait filter: `Type:Value`, several values with `|`, several types with `;`, e.g. `Fur:Golden Brown|Gray;Hat:Party Hat 2`.

parameters.name: query

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
